Cuidamos la atención al detalle, desde la gestión de reservas hasta la entrega y recogida de vehículos, buscando siempre la satisfacción de quienes confían en nosotros. Trabajar con Menorca On Wheels significa formar parte de un entorno dinámico, muy ligado al turismo y al contacto directo con clientes de diferentes países. Empresa local en constante crecimiento y evolución Descripción del puesto Como Adjunto de dirección, apoyarás en la gestión diaria de la empresa, dando soporte directo a la dirección en tareas administrativas, organizativas y de coordinación del equipo. Te encargarás de gestionar las reservas, planificar entregas y recogidas, preparar documentación básica de seguimiento (informes, listados, cuadros de mando sencillos) y apoyar en la comunicación interna y externa. También colaborarás en la atención al cliente, ya sea presencial, telefónica o por correo, ayudando en reservas, incidencias y dudas. Este es un puesto a jornada completa, presencial, ubicado en Baleares. Requisitos Aptitudes interpersonales y de comunicación: capacidad para relacionarte con diferentes personas, trato cercano y profesional, habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita en un entorno de cara al público. Aptitudes analíticas y organizativas: capacidad para analizar información básica, preparar pequeños informes, gestionar agendas y organizar tareas de forma eficiente. Orientación al servicio al cliente: experiencia o interés en atención al cliente, resolución de incidencias y respuesta rápida y amable a consultas en un entorno turístico. Conocimientos básicos de finanzas: manejo de facturas, control de cobros y pagos, revisión de documentación económica y apoyo en tareas administrativas relacionadas con la contabilidad. Otras aptitudes y cualificaciones: manejo fluido de herramientas ofimáticas (especialmente hojas de cálculo y correo electrónico), capacidad para trabajar en equipo, proactividad, responsabilidad. Conocimiento para extraer el máximo potencial de la IA, sacando informes y cruzando datos para tomas las mejores decisiones. Requisitos de idiomas: español, catalán, nivel medio de inglés y francés. Otros idiomas será muy valorado.

review_candidates.title: Account Manager - Western Europe
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity We’re looking for an experienced Account Manager to join our Sales team in Leuven and take ownership of growing and retaining our existing customer base across the region. Your mission is clear: renew, upsell, and cross-sell . You’ll manage the commercial relationship with your customers, secure renewals, and proactively uncover opportunities to expand Guardsquare’s footprint across teams, business units, geographies, and products. This is an Account Management role with a strong proactive account expansion mindset . We’re looking for someone who doesn’t simply manage existing business, but actively looks for what’s next. You know how to navigate complex organizations, open new doors within existing accounts, and turn untapped potential into commercial opportunities. Responsibilities Own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of customers across Western Europe . Drive the renewal process , protecting existing revenue and building strong, long-term customer relationships. Proactively identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities within your accounts. Expand Guardsquare’s footprint by identifying new teams, business units, geographies, use cases, and stakeholders. Build relationships beyond your existing contacts and engage relevant decision-makers across security, engineering, procurement, legal, and business teams. Understand your customers’ priorities and challenges, and connect them to the right Guardsquare solutions. Present Guardsquare solutions and demonstrate the value of expanding their current implementation. Identify potential renewal risks early and take the necessary commercial actions to protect the account. Work closely with Customer Service, Solutions Engineering, and other internal teams to support account growth and retention. Maintain accurate account plans, opportunities, pipeline, and sales activities in Salesforce. Profile At least 5 years of similar experience in B2B software sales or Account Management. Experience selling into BFSI or Fintech. Proven experience owning renewals, upselling, and cross-selling within an existing customer portfolio. Experience carrying and delivering against an annual ARR target . A genuine hunter mentality : you proactively create opportunities rather than waiting for customers to come to you. A strong track record of growing accounts and identifying untapped revenue potential. Experience navigating complex enterprise organizations and sales cycles with multiple stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen, and confidence in driving negotiations and closing business. Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, from day-to-day contacts to senior decision-makers. Comfortable prospecting within existing accounts , opening new conversations, and building relationships with new stakeholders. Experience working with CRM and sales tools such as Salesforce . Fluent professional French and English is required. Previous experience in cybersecurity, application security, or technical/developer-focused software sales is a strong plus. Willing to work from our Leuven office at least 3 days per week . What Guardsquare offers you A full-time position with a competitive salary package tailored to your experience. Ownership of a customer portfolio across Western Europe with plenty of opportunity to make a commercial impact. The tools, resources, and flexibility you need to successfully develop your career. A vibrant, international environment where you will collaborate with motivated, open-minded colleagues from diverse backgrounds. A collaborative workplace culture where your ideas are valued and implemented. A hybrid working model , combining flexibility with at least 3 days per week together in our Leuven office. At Guardsquare, we take pride in being a diverse and multicultural company with team members representing numerous nationalities. We value different perspectives and opinions throughout the business which has contributed to our being the market leader in mobile application security. You will be part of a dynamic team that strives for excellence and focuses on continuous education and enhancement in skills. We encourage & empower our trusted colleagues to share their opinions, actively collaborate, and continue to learn and grow. Ready to retain, grow, and expand some of Guardsquare’s key customer relationships across Western Europe? We’d love to hear from you. About Guardsquare Guardsquare offers the most complete approach to mobile application security on the market, delivering the highest level of protection, with ease. Guardsquare integrates seamlessly across the full development cycle, from mobile app security testing and code hardening to real-time threat detection and API security. Guardsquare provides enhanced mobile application security across the entire development process. More than 1,000 customers worldwide across all major industries rely on Guardsquare to help them identify security risks and protect their mobile applications and SDKs against reverse engineering and tampering in the ever-evolving threat landscape. Guardsquare is based in Leuven (Belgium) with offices in Ghent (Belgium), Boston (USA), and Munich (Germany), Glasgow (UK), Helsinki (Finland) and Singapore.
